Introduction
This document out lines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block
The technical specification of the auxiliary 
transformer: 
11/0.4 KV, 1000 / 630 KVA, off load tap changer, ONAN, delta /Yn05
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Hessain Hashem, tested by eng. Hasseb Hessain 
Bahboh, accepted by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman, 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem; HGPSC 
inspection general director, 
and approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel Baset: head 
sector of Aswan Dam 1,2 PS.
Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
The transformer must be out of service
The transformer isolated and earthed from two sides
